classification_policy: Every file-level origin/port classification remains UNREVIEWED; visible difference categories are not ownership or semantic-equivalence findings.

files.difference_category: slicer configuration definitions and printer-host integration

evidence.observation: Physical-printer config includes bbl_use_printhost and printer_agent options; printer_agent is absent in candidate blob.
Ordinary and organic tree-support branch distances are defined separately.
Candidate defines the ordinary tree-support branch distance at a different location; options and defaults require broader review.

files.difference_category: explicit SliceBeam config integration plus validation and diagnostics

evidence.observation: Comment and branch explicitly restore flat INI loading for SliceBeam config.
Corresponding INI load call is commented out.
Mobile adds numeric value validation; impact on accepted settings requires testing.
Mobile adds DynamicConfig diff reporting.

files.difference_category: mobile preset/cloud/bundle integration mixed with preset compatibility policy

evidence.observation: PresetOrigin parser distinguishes local/subscribed bundle namespaces and bare names; PresetOrigin is absent in candidate blob.
Info persistence skips project-embedded and bundled presets and includes sync state.
Candidate checks project-embedded presets but has no bundle-origin branch here.
Mobile has a broad preset-transfer option list; later portions include support, filament, tree-support and G-code settings, which can affect preset compatibility.

files.difference_category: app resource, preset-bundle import/selection, and active config resolution

evidence.observation: find_preset_vendor searches packaged profile resources; helper is absent in candidate blob.
Local bundle metadata and PresetOrigin are used while loading printer/process/filament presets; this origin-aware loading path is absent in candidate blob.
apply_vendor_config uses AppConfig and installs selected bundles from resources; helper is absent in candidate blob.

files.difference_category: G-code generation and Bambu-specific machine/template behavior

evidence.observation: X2D-specific hotend placeholder mapping; helper is absent in candidate blob.
Tool-change template config adds filament cooling, flush and interface values; these are generated-output semantics.
Top-level file_start_gcode is processed with deferred time and filament placeholders; matching hook is absent in candidate blob.

files.difference_category: G-code parsing, motion-time planning, and print-statistics post-processing

evidence.observation: Planner forward/reverse kernels use different signatures and recalculation conditions from candidate.
Candidate planner kernels use different control flow; this is not a formatting-only difference.
Mobile replaces inline print_time_sec and used_filament_length placeholders during G-code processing.
Layer changes are tracked by comparing the reserved marker after stripping BBL/compatible flavor variation.
